title: Derived change of rings along a morphism of sheaves of rings, computed by K-flat resolutions
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\varphi:\mathcal O\to\mathcal O'$ a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$; let $D(\mathcal O)$, $D(\mathcal O')$ be the derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of the abelian categories of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules and of $\mathcal O'$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For a complex $\mathcal P^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O$-modules write $\mathcal P^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal O'$ for the complex of $\mathcal O'$-modules obtained by applying the change of rings $-\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal O'$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] termwise. Then: (1) if $\alpha:\mathcal P^\bullet\to\mathcal Q^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] between K-flat complexes of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex], the induced map $\alpha\otimes1:\mathcal P^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal O'\to\mathcal Q^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal O'$ is a quasi-isomorphism of complexes of $\mathcal O'$-modules; (2) consequently there is an exact functor of triangulated categories $L\varphi^*=-\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O}\mathcal O':D(\mathcal O)\to D(\mathcal O')$, the left derived functor of the termwise change of rings $K(\mathcal O)\to D(\mathcal O')$, $\mathcal G^\bullet\mapsto\mathcal G^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal O'$, which is everywhere defined and computed by K-flat complexes: for every K-flat resolution $\mathcal P^\bullet\to\mathcal G^\bullet$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, lem-pc-kflat-resolution] the canonical map $L\varphi^*\mathcal G^\bullet\to\mathcal P^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal O'$ (inverse of the map induced by the resolution) is an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal O')$, and for two K-flat resolutions $\mathcal P^\bullet\to\mathcal G^\bullet$, $\mathcal P'^\bullet\to\mathcal G^\bullet$ the resulting isomorphism $\mathcal P^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal O'\cong\mathcal P'^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal O'$ in $D(\mathcal O')$ is canonical (compatible with composition for a third resolution).

proof.text: Build the sectionwise extension-of-scalars functor from the landed changeOfRingsPresheaf and changeOfRingsHom_naturality [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Identity, composition and additivity hold sectionwise. Compose with sheafification. Extension of scalars and sheafification are additive by their adjunctions to additive restriction/forgetful functors (Mathlib Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive). This gives E with the exact objects and maps required.
Apply [lem-pur-change-of-rings-kflat-quasi-iso] to E, using its reflexive object identification and the proved morphism identification, to obtain clause (1).

Let F be E.mapHomotopyCategory followed by the derived localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Mathlib supplies its shift compatibility and triangulatedness. Define S to consist of homotopy-category objects represented by K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Each homotopy object is the quotient of a complex G; [lem-pc-kflat-resolution] gives P → G, and quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff shows that its homotopy image is a resolution from S. For a quasi-isomorphism between objects in S choose their K-flat representatives and lift the morphism through the full quotient functor. quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff gives a chain quasi-isomorphism; clause (1) makes its termwise E image a quasi-isomorphism. Localization.inverts then makes its F image an isomorphism. Apply [lem-pur-left-derived-from-kflat-class] to F and S. Its pointwise existence, universal derived pair and triangulatedness supply clause (2). Its counit-isomorphism clause applied to the representation (P,hP,rfl) supplies the final clause for every K-flat P.
